design_state: No SMP bulk outcome data received or opened.
diagnosis: The common circular phase null creates an artificial seam. Under a monotonic parent-abundance trajectory, circular wrap produces implausible negative shifted H values, making the unwrapped observed positive H appear extreme even when there is no event-aligned threshold effect.

decision.replacement_rule: Develop and pretest a non-circular common-offset temporal null that preserves physical MasterSite/block synchrony and never wraps events across block boundaries.

boundary: This design repair occurs before SMP outcomes. No real-data result motivated the null change.
